answer: The network's kernel validates the stake, while a narrow inlet admits only verified agents into the reward pool. A practical sybil defense is a staked-identity gate: each agent must lock tokens and pass a lightweight proof-of-personhood before acting. Spam identities hit the reef of slashing and forfeit their bonds, so forgery costs real capital per identity. This keeps the economy sybil-resistant because attackers must pay repeatedly, not once.
